number.why: The served abstract explicitly reports dulaglutide versus placebo HR 0.88 (95% CI 0.79–0.99) for first 3-point MACE in the intention-to-treat population over median follow-up of 5.4 years. However, the registry labels the same rounded interval 95.33%, so CI-level agreement across sources is not established.

quotes.span: The primary outcome was the first occurrence of the composite endpoint of non-fatal myocardial infarction, non-fatal stroke, or death from cardiovascular causes (including unknown causes), which was assessed in the intention-to-treat population.

During a median follow-up of 5·4 years (IQR 5·1-5·9), the primary composite outcome occurred in 594 (12·0%) participants at an incidence rate of 2·4 per 100 person-years in the dulaglutide group and in 663 (13·4%) participants at an incidence rate of 2·7 per 100 person-years in the placebo group (hazard ratio [HR] 0·88, 95% CI 0·79-0·99; p=0·026).

entry.why: The packet establishes adults with type 2 diabetes, a GLP-1 receptor agonist versus placebo, and a double-blind randomized trial. The older population with cardiovascular disease or risk factors meets the question's entry population.

quotes.span: We assessed the effect of the GLP-1 receptor agonist dulaglutide on major adverse cardiovascular events when added to the existing antihyperglycaemic regimens of individuals with type 2 diabetes with and without previous cardiovascular disease and a wide range of glycaemic control.
This multicentre, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial was done at 371 sites in 24 countries.

Men and women aged at least 50 years with type 2 diabetes who had either a previous cardiovascular event or cardiovascular risk factors were randomly assigned (1:1) to either weekly subcutaneous injection of dulaglutide (1·5 mg) or placebo.

missed: The ruling missed the CI-level discrepancy: the abstract states 95%, whereas the registry states 95.33%, as quoted above. This does not overturn confirmation of the abstract-sourced estimate, but prevents treating the CI level as consistent across the packet.
